title: SaaS Admin Dashboard
objective: Compose a dashboard with navigation, metrics, a table and responsive layout changes.

milestones.title: Sidebar and toolbar
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate sidebar and toolbar in the project.
Keep the implementation responsive, semantic and maintainable.

milestones.title: Metric cards and chart placeholders
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate metric cards and chart placeholders in the project.
Keep the implementation responsive, semantic and maintainable.

milestones.title: Readable data table and filters
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate readable data table and filters in the project.
Keep the implementation responsive, semantic and maintainable.

milestones.title: Responsive layout across widths
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate responsive layout across widths in the project.
Keep the implementation responsive, semantic and maintainable.

stretch_features: Add a documented theme variant or design token where appropriate.
Add a visual regression check for one representative state.
Document a trade-off or browser-support limitation.
tests: Build with the configured Vite/Tailwind workflow.
Inspect narrow, medium and wide viewport layouts.
Check keyboard navigation, focus indication, semantic roles and contrast.
Verify that required utility classes appear in generated CSS.
review_method: Static source checks plus human review; project code is not executed in the production FastAPI process.
status_note: Draft project outline; verify the implementation against the resolved dependencies before publication.
